title: Audit icon-button labeling and tooltip timing during loading and theme switches
creator: Maya Chen
description: Investigate and resolve inconsistent tooltip behavior and accessible labeling for icon-only buttons when they transition into loading or disabled states, and when the user switches themes (light/dark/high-contrast). This ticket covers design spec updates, token recommendations, dev handoff, and a small regression test matrix.
background: Several recent regressions were reported from product teams and support relating to icon buttons: tooltips appearing briefly then disappearing when the button swaps to a spinner; screen readers reading stale labels after an aria-label is replaced by a loading indicator; tooltip contrast failures in high-contrast theme; and tooltip flicker when the app toggles theme during animation. Existing fixes have been ad-hoc across components; we need a unified, documented approach that prevents layout shift and meets a11y standards.
decisions: Keep DOM node for button content stable: replace visual content via CSS where possible instead of unmounting nodes to avoid losing accessible name references.
Tooltips should respect a 200ms show-delay and 100ms hide-delay to avoid flicker during quick state transitions (empirically derived).
When a button enters loading state, announce via aria-live polite: 'Action name — loading' rather than swapping aria-label to 'Loading' to preserve action context for screen reader users.
Focus ring scaling should be implemented using transform: scale() rather than changing outline thickness across themes to avoid layout reflow.
High-contrast theme to use token overrides for tooltip background and text to achieve minimum 4.5:1 contrast with icon-button background when anchored.
acceptance_criteria: Icon-only button maintains accessible name when showing spinner; screen readers announce 'X — loading' (aria-live) instead of losing context.
Tooltip show/hide uses 200ms/100ms delays; no flicker observed during brief loading transitions in manual QA and replay on CI.
No visual layout shift when toggling between icon and spinner in all themes (light/dark/high-contrast).
Tooltip color tokens meet WCAG contrast in high-contrast theme and match design token naming conventions.
Design spec and token changes documented in Figma and the design system doc; developer PR includes unit & visual regression tests linked here.
tasks: Design: update Figma frames with stable DOM approach and tooltip timing annotations (Maya)

Engineering: implement DOM-stable spinner pattern, aria-live announcement, tooltip delay params, and theme token hooks (Samir)
QA: create regression matrix (themes x state transitions x platforms) and automated visual tests (Kara)
Accessibility review: schedule with a11y guild and incorporate feedback (Liam)
Docs: write entry in component changelog + migration notes for any API changes (Maya)
Release: coordinate with releases to include in ds-2026.03 and call out in release notes (PM)
